title: P3 service/control: arguments
description: Built-in write tool service/control {service, verb}. In the attempt tools/list the service and verb come as an enum from the tenant catalog and the role service_control. Without a card, only a verb from services[].no_card (default restart) in a task without untrusted_seen; start and stop go through a card (APR-18, INJ-15). Each initiator needs their own service.control:<service> (D-73).
